name: unchecked-send-payouts
inspiration: SWC-104 unchecked call return value (King of the Ether, 2016)

known_bugs.description: The return value of `send` is discarded. A recipient that cannot accept ETH causes the transfer to fail silently after the claim has already been zeroed, stranding the funds and destroying the recipient's entitlement.

Neither credit nor payout rejects the zero address. Value credited to address(0) can be paid out to address(0) — send succeeds to an empty account — so the ETH leaves the contract to an address no one controls and is irrecoverably burned while the ledger entry is cleared.
